Package com.hkust.marketplace.models

Class Listing

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.models.Listing
Direct Known Subclasses:
GiveawayListing, LendListing, SaleListing
public abstract class Listing extends Object
Abstract base for a listing. Concrete kinds are SaleListing, LendListing and GiveawayListing; each supplies its type and price display. TODO: Persist to database and add photo storage when backend is ready.
